topic: Chacha Jee's car horn gets stuck and will not stop.

episode.title: Chacha Jee Ka Horn Band Hi Nahi Hota!

shots.narration: ہارن ایسا بجا کہ چچا جی خود اچھل پڑے!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D animated Pakistani home driveway, plain unbranded car parked beside a washing bucket and coiled garden hose, no writing anywhere.
shots.action: Chacha jolts upright in the driver's seat as the steering wheel horn pad visibly trembles.
shots.mood: Wide startled eyes, bouncing moustache, warm sunny comedy.

shots.narration: چچا بولے، یہ تو میرے بائیں ہاتھ کا کھیل ہے!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, view through the parked car's open passenger doorway, blank dashboard surfaces, sunny driveway beyond.
shots.action: Chacha confidently taps the trembling horn pad with his left hand.
shots.mood: Puffed chest and smug grin beside Pappu's patient expression.

shots.narration: مگر ہارن نے چچا جی کی ایک نہ مانی!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, parked car interior with an unmarked steering wheel and open passenger door.
shots.action: Pappu covers his ears beside the still-trembling horn pad.
shots.mood: Pappu's scrunched face contrasts with Chacha's stubborn confidence.

shots.narration: پپو بولا، ذرا پیچھے ہو کر تو دیکھیں!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, side view into the parked car, driver's seat positioned unusually close to the steering wheel.
shots.action: Pappu points toward the empty space behind Chacha's seat.
shots.mood: Patient raised eyebrows and a clear helpful gesture.

shots.narration: چچا بولے، پہلے انجن بند کرکے دیکھتے ہیں!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, close view of the parked car's plain ignition and steering wheel, no logos or dashboard lettering.
shots.action: Chacha turns the ignition key while the horn pad continues trembling.
shots.mood: Determined squint and increasingly ruffled moustache.

shots.narration: چاچی آئیں تو چچا کی ساری ماہری غائب!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunny driveway beside the parked car's open driver doorway, washing bucket and coiled hose nearby.
shots.action: Chachi leans into the open driver doorway to inspect the steering wheel.
shots.mood: Chachi's sharp inspecting gaze, Chacha's sheepish smile, Pappu's hopeful face.

shots.narration: چچا بولے، خرابی ضرور گاڑی کے اندر ہے!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, view through the open driver doorway, Chacha seated close against the steering wheel.
shots.action: Chacha points solemnly toward the car's dashboard.
shots.mood: Comically serious confidence against Chachi's knowing raised eyebrow.

shots.narration: چاچی بولیں، خرابی نہیں، آپ کا پیٹ ہارن دبا رہا ہے!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, clear side close-up inside the parked car, Chacha's round belly visibly pressing the central horn pad.
shots.action: Chachi points directly at Chacha's belly depressing the horn.
shots.mood: Chachi's victorious grin and Chacha's wide-eyed realization.

shots.narration: پیٹ پیچھے، ہارن خاموش؛ اب گاڑی کی دھلائی ہوگی!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, wide view through the open driver doorway, washing bucket and garden hose prominent beside Pappu.
shots.action: Chachi slides Chacha's seat backward, freeing the horn pad from his belly.
shots.mood: Chachi beams triumphantly, Chacha looks sheepish, Pappu grins beside the waiting

episode.endHook: Ab gaari dhulegi, ya Chacha Jee?
episode.description: چچا جی کی گاڑی کا ہارن بجنے لگا تو پورا صحن گونج اٹھا! پپو کی سمجھ داری اور چاچی جان کی تیز نظر نے اصل مسئلہ پکڑ لیا۔
